title: PAD RECONNECT ACTION
why: The disconnect card offered an enabled resume action while the pad was absent. The critic found this misleading.
now: The existing action says reconnect and stays disabled until the reserved pad returns. A resumes as before and restores the normal pause action. The returned pad also permits a click on that same action.
